Results.ReviewText: Made to last! Incredible heat capability and the heat distribution is amazing. I’ve also never had a grill that prevented flare ups like the design of my Weber. Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber grill and everything from delivery, to assembly, to use has been fantastic. The assembly took a little over an hour and I didn't require a second person. The assembly instructions were fantastic and honestly I've never had any assembly go as smoothly as this did. After firing it up, I found out quickly how efficient this grill is. My old grill hovered between 450-500 degrees with all 4 burners on high. This Weber has Spirit (pun intended)! With all 3 burners on high, it sits at 550-600 degrees. So I'm learning to adjust my grilling to a more efficient grill, but totally worth it! There don't seem to be any cold spots either. I've only grilled up some steaks and burgers, but it's all turned out great. Weber isn't the least expensive grill on the market and there's a reason...everything about it is high quality. I'd recommend a Weber grill to anyone looking to buy their first or fifth grill!
Results.Title: Absolutely excellent, high-quality grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit grill and i think it’s great. My only complaint is that Weber needs to figure out a way to avoid rusting. My last one only lasted 5 yrs because the legs (the ones without wheels) rusted so badly it wouldn’t stand and Weber warranty does not cover that (or at least that’s what i was told). On this one I have applied Rustoleum on the legs in hopes that will help. Yes, it is always covered when not in use, so was my last one. So if the Rustoleum doesn’t work I'm done with Webers.
Results.Title: Rusted legs

I’ve had Weber grills for over two decades so when it came time to replace my current grill it was a no brainer that it would be a Weber.  They are well built and last for years and easy to use and care for. The three burner design makes it easy to regulate the heat to provide excellent grilling results.
Best bang for the buck hands down!

Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
